about.description: DRAM is an ETF perpetual listed on Crypto.com, tracking Roundhill Memory ETF, margined and cash-settled in USD. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 1h. Up to 50x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
